scatter-chart.stories.ts's Default story changed its x-label/y-label from single letters ("X"/"Y") to "X value"/"Y value" -- a rotated single capital letter is inherently illegible (reads as a generic chevron regardless of font), which multi-character labels fix. chart.class.ts's buildScales() now sets the radial (r) scale's ticks.z: 1 so Chart.js draws ring labels after datasets instead of before, fixing labels (e.g. "20"/"15") being partly painted over by data wedges. The current capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.

box-plot.class.ts now applies the resolved --lr-chart-grid-color and --lr-chart-tick-color to the x axis as well as the y axis, replacing Chart.js defaults with the documented theme contract. The current capture reflects that intentional consistency fix and awaits human visual review.

Awaits human visual review.

The idle-state bar fill swapped from --lr-color-brand-quiet (a subtle panel-fill token, ~1.1-1.3:1 contrast against the surface) to --lr-color-brand-border-normal (~4:1 in both themes), fixing a WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast failure. The current capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.

Under a right-to-left host the code body now stays left-to-right (direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate), so its lines start at the left edge and a long line's scroll origin is the start of the code instead of its right-hand end; the header keeps the page direction. The rtl capture reflects that intentional change and awaits human visual review.

This new right-to-left fixture (left-to-right code body opening at the start of the code, c++ badge and ./src/main.cpp file name in character order, header in page direction) is enrolled as automated evidence and awaits human visual review before its baseline is promoted.

The v8 markdown API replaced the sanitize boolean with a tri-state html-mode attribute; the story copy now documents html-mode="trusted" instead of .sanitize=${false}. The current capture reflects that intentional content change and awaits human visual review. The rtl capture additionally changes because inline code now isolates left-to-right (direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate) inside right-to-left prose, so a code span's dashes and punctuation keep their source order; that intentional change also awaits human visual review.

item-chunk-count/item-embedding-status/item-attempts now carry unicode-bidi: plaintext, fixing RTL word/digit reordering in their status text (e.g. "26 of 48 chunks embedded" no longer reordering). The current rtl capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.

lr-conversation-item's excerpt template now renders its fallback text node before the (usually empty) excerpt <slot>, fixing a dir="auto" first-strong-character detection bug where the preceding empty <slot> element caused Chromium to fall back to the ambient RTL host direction instead of the excerpt's own (English) content -- which silently flipped text-overflow: ellipsis truncation to the wrong end of the string under RTL. The current rtl capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review.

The virtualized cell's stream-output part now carries direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate, matching the code-input block rendered above it, instead of inheriting the ambient RTL host direction and right-aligning independently of the input. The current rtl capture reflects that fix and awaits human visual review. The rtl capture additionally changes because rendered Markdown code in notebook cells now reads left-to-right (direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate) under a right-to-left host; that intentional change also awaits human visual review.
